description: List a directory or find files/literal text without a shell or command approval. For project overview, start with mode=list at the root. Search results do not authorize editing; use read_file for a versioned read.

propertyDescriptions.path: File or directory to search, default workspace root. Absolute host paths are not accepted. Explicit paths can target normally excluded build/dependency directories.
propertyDescriptions.glob: Optional relative filename filter supporting *, **, ? and flat brace alternatives such as *.{json,md,toml}. At most 32 alternatives; no nested braces, character classes, regex or parent traversal. Use forward slashes. A basename filter searches all visited depths, not only the root.
propertyDescriptions.query: Optional literal text to locate. Omit to list matching filenames.
propertyDescriptions.mode: list returns files and directories, default one level deep; search (default) recursively locates files or literal text. Omit query with list.
propertyDescriptions.maxDepth: Maximum levels to visit: 1 means the selected directory only. Defaults to 1 for list, configured searchMaxDepth for search; capped by the configured limit.

guidance: For project purpose/structure questions, call mode=list at the root, then read the root README/manifest or one relevant child directory. Do not recursively explore installed dependencies, caches or unrelated files to explain the project. Default scans skip dependency/build/cache/control directories and symlinks; explicit paths can inspect ordinary excluded directories. Partial results are not absence: narrow path/depth instead of repeating a broad scan. Stop discovery once enough evidence supports a concise answer; state uncertainty when no project description exists.
